name: enforces IDs and names while supporting CRUD
input: duplicate IDs, case-insensitive names, and deletion
test:
manager = RecipeManager()
assert manager.add_recipe('2', 'Pasta', ['noodles', 'tomato'])
assert not manager.add_recipe('2', 'Soup', ['water'])
assert not manager.add_recipe('3', 'PASTA', ['other'])
assert manager.get_recipe('2') == {'id': '2', 'name': 'Pasta', 'ingredients': ['noodles', 'tomato']}
assert manager.update_recipe('2', 'pasta', ['noodles'])
assert manager.get_recipe('2') == {'id': '2', 'name': 'pasta', 'ingredients': ['noodles']}
assert manager.delete_recipe('2')
assert manager.get_recipe('2') is None
assert manager.add_recipe('4', 'Pasta', ['noodles'])
assert not manager.delete_recipe('missing')

name: search and list use ingredient count then numeric ID ordering
input: matching recipe names with tied ingredient counts
test:
manager = RecipeManager()
assert manager.add_recipe('10', 'Tomato Pasta', ['tomato'])
assert manager.add_recipe('2', 'Tomato Soup', ['tomato'])
assert manager.add_recipe('7', 'Tomato Salad', ['tomato', 'basil'])
assert [recipe['id'] for recipe in manager.search_recipes('TOMATO')] == ['2', '10', '7']
assert [recipe['id'] for recipe in manager.get_all_recipes()] == ['2', '10', '7']

name: editing requires an existing user and respects name conflicts
test:
manager = RecipeManager()
assert manager.add_recipe('1', 'Soup', ['water'])
assert manager.add_recipe('2', 'Curry', ['spice'])
assert not manager.edit_recipe('u1', '1', 'Stew', ['water'])
assert manager.add_user('u1', 'Ada')
assert not manager.add_user('u1', 'Grace')
assert not manager.edit_recipe('u1', '1', 'CURRY', ['water'])
assert manager.edit_recipe('u1', '1', 'Stew', ['water', 'salt'])
assert manager.get_recipe('1') == {'id': '1', 'name': 'Stew', 'ingredients': ['water', 'salt']}
